about: V3 audio slots. Each plays FINAL, else TEMP, else nothing. Voice text and timing mirror navislabs_v3_voiceover_screen_map.json (generated together).

voiceover.text: Your company already has the answer.
voiceover.shows: A line of light gathers five Acme signals: decision, customer, commitment, meeting, context — each with the system it came from.

voiceover.text: It's just scattered across the systems where work happens.
voiceover.shows: The line breaks; each signal returns to its own system: Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Meet, Google Drive, Google Docs, Slack.

voiceover.text: People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.
voiceover.shows: Split: PEOPLE copy pieces into a note by hand | AGENTS: a new session with company context: —.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs brings those signals together.
voiceover.shows: NavisLabs lockup (website treatment) with its line.

voiceover.text: One understanding. Two ways in.
voiceover.shows: The line branches: NAVIS APPLICATION · for people | NAVIS DEVELOPER · for developers + AI agents.

voiceover.text: Every email, meeting, document and commitment — turned into what's true now.
voiceover.shows: The six live systems emit signals into NavisLabs; seven roadmap systems sit beside them marked 'Coming soon'; the signals become Customers, Projects, Decisions, Commitments, People, Meetings — ONE CURRENT UNDERSTANDING.

voiceover.text: In Navis Application, people see what changed — and what needs a decision.
voiceover.shows: Today: 'Good morning, Abhishek.' and 'Today at a glance': Decisions, Risks, Actions today, Meetings, Waiting on you, Updates.

voiceover.text: Acme's renewal moved.
voiceover.shows: What changed: 'Just learned — Acme Corp's renewal moved to Nov 28'; then the Acme priority card.

voiceover.text: Navis shows why — every fact with its source and its time.
voiceover.shows: 'Why this matters' opens 'Why Navis surfaced this'; evidence rows (email, meeting, document, commitment) with TRACE notes: source, timeline, freshness.

voiceover.text: It's waiting on you, so Navis prepares the reply.
voiceover.shows: Waiting on you: '1 person is waiting on your reply' → Review & reply → Review draft → 'Preparing the draft…' → the draft.

voiceover.text: A person decides.
voiceover.shows: Abhishek selects one sentence and writes his own; 'Saved' → 'Save changes'.

voiceover.text: The company acts.
voiceover.shows: Approve & send → 'Approved — sending' → 'Sending…' → Gmail accepted → 'Reply sent · Gmail accepted the message.'

voiceover.text: Agents get the same understanding, in the tools they use.
voiceover.shows: Hard cut: VS Code on the NavisLabs repository, Claude Code in a terminal (prompt abhishekmeena@Abhisheks-MacBook-Pro-8 NavisLabs %); task 'Update the Acme renewal workflow.'

voiceover.text: Connect once — MCP, API, SDKs or CLI.
voiceover.shows: Navis Developer Console → Connect: MCP, Developer API, SDKs, CLI, each with its real command; private preview.

voiceover.text: The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.
voiceover.shows: navis - navis_get_relevant_context (MCP) → ACME CORP: renewal date (moved), owner, decision, commitment, last customer response — each with source and freshness.

voiceover.text: Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.
voiceover.shows: The real TypeScript SDK call (new Navis(...); navis.context()) with today's install line, and POST /developer/context → a structured response; 'No model is called · Navis grounds · your agent reasons'.

voiceover.text: Every request is checked against identity and permissions.
voiceover.shows: Agent → identity (its own key) → permissions on the credential → AUTHORIZED; a read-only key → DENIED with the exact refusal.

voiceover.text: The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
voiceover.shows: The diff lands in acme-renewal.ts (renewsOn Nov 28, current annual terms); Console → Runs → Run: timeline Context · Tool · Tool · Outcome; cost/tokens not recorded (—); outcome 'Not judged'.

voiceover.text: The person and the agent acted on the same event.
voiceover.shows: HERO: Navis Application (people) and Navis Developer (developers + AI agents) either side of NavisLabs; the Acme signal arrives in both.

voiceover.text: Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.
voiceover.shows: Three matched rows light up between the products: the renewal fact, its Gmail source, its freshness.

voiceover.text: One company. One understanding. Two ways in.
voiceover.shows: ONE COMPANY · ONE UNDERSTANDING · TWO WAYS IN.

voiceover.text: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.
voiceover.shows: Type: models / agents / tools change; the agent clients appear with their real verification status feeding Navis Developer: Claude Code (live verified), Cursor, Codex, VS Code (configuration verified), any MCP client.

voiceover.text: Your company keeps its history.
voiceover.shows: DECISION → EXECUTION → OUTCOME (BUILDING) → LEARNING (NEXT).

voiceover.text: Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.
voiceover.shows: COMPANY-OWNED · MODEL-NEUTRAL · SHARED UNDERSTANDING.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.
voiceover.shows: End card: NavisLabs lockup, the website headline, both products, Book Demo · navislabs.in.

music.style: San Francisco late-night engineering: low drones, restrained electronic pulse under the developer section, warm pads under the application, one resolving piano chord. No trailer hits.

sections.brief: a subtle pulse under the problem
NavisLabs: low swell; the systems connect
faster, precise developer rhythm — Navis Developer
slow build: same truth, then the moat

sfx.style: Understated: keys, enter, clicks, selection, one notification, confirm, sent, deny, two soft air transitions.
